text:
alex: heads-up 1 design pass uploaded for Playground streaming + quick-insert prompt shelf. links in the thread: https://figma.redwood/designs/stream-ux

mira: skimmed. main things I care about: interruption model, token visibility on mobile, and a non-disruptive insert flow from prompt library.

alex: interruption model proposal: single "Stop" action stops tokens and leaves partial output. separate action "Try again" restarts with same prompt. keyboard: `Esc` = stop, `Ctrl+R` = try again.

tony: infra note: stopping should keep a short-lived KV snapshot to allow fast retries. we can keep KV for 10s by default, configurable per deployment. need client debounce ~400ms to avoid rapid hitting.

jess: accessibility: label the stop control with aria text: `aria-label="Stop generation, preserve partial output"`. Also announce toast via `aria-live="assertive"`: "Generation stopped  partial result available."

alex: good point. for copy i want to change "Tokens used" -> "Compute tokens" and show hover tooltip: "Estimated compute tokens billed for this chat session." prefer this over "Session tokens"?

mira: "Compute tokens" is clearer to engineers. ops teams will like the explicitness.

tony: UI placement question: counter in composer vs fixed header badge. my vote: composer for imminency, header badge for long-running multi-turn threads. implement both, show header badge once thread > 5 turns.

jess: keyboard access: make prompt insert reachable by Tab and space/enter. ensure insertion announces: "Prompt inserted: <title>" using `aria-live=polite`. keep focus in composer when inserting.

alex: micro-interaction: animate a 120ms flash on inserted text so the user notices. also add `preserveCursor` flag to the insert API so caret doesn't jump.

tony: agree on `preserveCursor`. API snippet for client teams:

```js
// prompt insert example
client.insertPrompt({ id: 'p-123', preserveCursor: true, focus: true })
```

alex: good. token counter should update live but throttled (200ms). clicking counter expands a compact panel with per-turn token breakdown and CSV export.

mira: mobile: make counter tap-to-expand modal. avoid tiny badges in mobile footer. also confirm the regen/try-again button isn't primary style. it should be outline/secondary.

jess: copy tweak for toast when regen fails due to expired KV: "Fast retry unavailable  warming model. Try again in a few seconds." keep language simple for screen readers.

tony: rate-limiting: server will enforce per-user regen quotas; client will show cooldown with a small countdown next to Try again, and disable the button with `aria-disabled=true`.

alex: linking a couple of mock images: https://figma.redwood/img/stream-shimmer.png (shimmer to text), https://figma.redwood/img/stop-tryagain-layout.png, https://figma.redwood/img/prompt-shelf-inline.png

mira: tiny UI nit: reduce the prominence of the try-again button. users hit it reflexively in some workflows. make it secondary + lower-contrast.

jess: localization: use "Try again" instead of "Regenerate"  shorter and less technical. fits localization teams.

ops-bot: Reminder: design sync scheduled at 1896130600 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

alex: assigning follow-ups: owner=alex, action@tony (KV timeout + debounce), action@mira (mobile counter layout), action@jess (a11y copy + keyboard flows). will drop updated figma before sync. :sparkles:
